scores.notes: Both show a wet sandy seabed with rivulets between towering green-blue water walls under dark storm cloud, with rocky desert banks; left looks toward the far shore and right back toward the fire pillar, so the palms versus mesas and walled town fit opposite viewpoints rather than a different place. Followed scorer A.

Left (beside the pig) Moses is bald on the crown with only a short white fringe and a shorter beard; right (striking the rock) Moses has a full head of long white hair. The hairline conflicts. Followed scorer B.

The left description says only 'several disciples' and never names Peter. The foreground net-carrier with curly greying hair resembles the right-hand Peter, but the description does not single out a figure. Followed scorer B.

The left description says only 'several disciples' and does not name Peter. The foreground net-carrier resembles the Peter stepping onto the waves, but the subject is not singled out. Followed scorer B.

The left path runs through a gorge between tall red cliffs topped with palms. The right shore is low, rocky and scrubby, with a walled hilltop town on a headland and no cliffs anywhere. The landforms conflict. Followed scorer B.
The left description says only 'several disciples' and does not name Peter. The net-carrier resembles the Peter at the brazier, but the description does not single out a figure. Followed scorer B.

The right description says only 'several disciples' and does not name Peter. The front net-carrier resembles the courtyard Peter (curly dark greying hair, beard), but the subject is not singled out. Followed scorer B.

The right description says only 'several disciples' and does not name Peter. The foreground net-carrier resembles the leaping Peter, but the description does not single out a figure. Followed scorer B.

The left Jesus is clear (long dark hair, beard). The crucified figure on the right is a tiny distant shape: even zoomed, its head is about a dozen pixels, so hair and beard are only hinted and the face cannot be read. Followed scorer A.
Left Moses at the sea has a full head of swept-back grey-white hair; right Moses beside the pig is bald on the crown with only a side fringe. The hairline conflicts. Followed scorer B.
Left Moses beside the pig is bald on top with a short white fringe; right seated Moses has a full head of long wavy white hair. The hairline conflicts. Followed scorer B.

Both are round pits of pale stone blocks with sandy floors. Left is a wide enclosure open to a dark night sky with torchlight, earth, shrubs and palms on its rim, and a barred gate. Right is a deep narrow shaft, evenly and brightly lit, with a broad paved stone apron at its rim and no vegetation. The rim and lighting conflict. Followed scorer A's verdict with these cues.
